name: Wankhede Stadium
pitchReport: True bounce with good carry. New ball seams for the first 4 overs, then the surface flattens for stroke-makers.
outfieldNote: Lightning quick outfield — boundaries come easy once the ball is in the gap.

name: Melbourne Cricket Ground
pitchReport: Hard and lively. Pacers get steep bounce; batters who trust the bounce can free their arms through point and midwicket.
outfieldNote: Vast square — singles are honest, misfields get punished.

name: Lords
pitchReport: Classic Lords slope. Early movement both ways; scoreboard pressure if you lose early wickets.
outfieldNote: Lush and slightly heavy after the morning dew.

name: Eden Gardens
pitchReport: Dry top with grip for spinners from the middle overs. Pace-on into the pitch still holds.
outfieldNote: Big boundaries square of the wicket; straight hits are the safer sixes.

name: Dubai International Stadium
pitchReport: Slowish two-paced strip. Change-ups and cutters bite; pure pace can sit up.
outfieldNote: Skiddy outfield after sunset — keep the ball along the carpet.
weather: Dry desert heat, no dew early

name: SuperSport Park
pitchReport: Green tinge with carry. First-use seamers will love the corridor; later overs favour clean strikers.
outfieldNote: Fast and true — place it and run hard for twos.
